card.title: 61st INFANTRY REGIMENT
card.flavorText: The 61st Infantry Regiment was a subordinate unit of the 4th Infantry Division of the Imperial Japanese Army. In April 1942 the 4th Division was assigned to the 14th Army and shipped to the Philippines to participate in the Battle of Bataan. The division then played a major part in the Japanese victory in the Battle of Corregidor where units of the 61st Infantry Regiment were the first to land on the island. Despite heavy resistance the regiment managed to secure a beachhead until the reinforcements arrived and managed to drive the enemies away. After the Philippines Campaign of 1941–42 the division was returned home for security duties. The division did not see much combat after that and ended the war in Thailand where it was disbanded after the war.
